clue.text: Bird with a cod's head in its crop

indicators.note: one piece is placed within the other, as food sits in a crop

parts.note: a maw is the crop or stomach of a bird or animal

indicators.note: the head of the word cod is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A bird has swallowed the head of a cod, which now sits in its crop.
explanation.walkthrough: The C (head of cod) comes before 'a' inside the crop, though the clue lists 'a' first.
explanation.definitionFit: The macaw is a large, brightly coloured tropical parrot.

clue.text: Understand gunner coming in spoils spring celebration

indicators.note: one pair of pieces enters the middle of the other word

parts.note: to spoil is to mar, so spoils gives mars
dig is slang for understand, as in 'I dig it'
RA, the Royal Artillery, is the crossword's usual gunner

explanation.surface: Someone who understands that an arriving soldier spoils a spring festival.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming in' signals the container. Mardi Gras is Shrove Tuesday, just before Lent, which falls in late winter or spring.
explanation.definitionFit: Mardi Gras is the Shrove Tuesday carnival, a festival held before Lent.

clue.text: Father of Wordsworth's man

parts.note: a quotation from Wordsworth's poem 'My Heart Leaps Up': the young one is the parent of the grown man

explanation.walkthrough: Wordsworth wrote 'The Child is father of the Man': this clue reverses the riddle, asking who fathers the man.
explanation.definitionFit: In the poem the youngster is said to be the parent of the grown-up he becomes.

clue.text: Was canvas showing a festive occasion?

parts.note: taken as written
sails were made of canvas, so canvas stands for sail

explanation.surface: A question about whether a sheet of canvas made a party.
explanation.definitionFit: A wassail is a merry drinking celebration, traditionally at Christmas or Twelfth Night.

clue.text: It appears low, to get money in the dark thus

definitions.text: It appears low, to get money in the dark thus

parts.words: It appears low, to get money in the dark thus
parts.note: read as the glow of a night sky body seen low on the horizon, and as earning a second wage secretly, as if after dark

explanation.surface: A riddle about something seen low in the sky and earning cash after dark.
explanation.walkthrough: The verb sense is to hold a second, undeclared job, done as if by night; the noun is the light seen in the dark.
explanation.definitionFit: Moonlighting is working a second job on the side, and the noun is the glow from the night sky.

clue.text: Silver found in lake is very poor

indicators.note: one piece is discovered sitting inside the other

parts.note: a mere is a lake or pond
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver discovered in a lake turns out to be of poor quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Meagre means scanty or deficient, so very poor in amount.

clue.text: One way to cross a motorway perhaps — or mountains?

definitions.text: One way to cross a motorway perhaps
definitions.meaning: a bridge carrying a road over another road
to go over a mountain pass, read as two words

explanation.surface: Ways of crossing a big road, or a mountain range.
explanation.definitionFit: A flyover bridge carries traffic above a highway; read in two parts it means crossing a col.

clue.text: Hotels unusually empty here in Africa

indicators.note: these letters appear in an unusual order, rearranged

parts.note: something empty holds nothing, the letter O resembling zero

explanation.surface: In this African place the hotels are oddly vacant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' rearranges HOTELS together with O, the empty circle. 'here in Africa' points to the country as the place meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Lesotho is a small kingdom entirely surrounded by South Africa.

clue.text: Get 'is raft mended by an artisan

indicators.note: something mended has been put back together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A Cockney asks a craftsman to get his raft repaired.
explanation.definitionFit: A gas fitter is a tradesman who installs and repairs gas pipes and appliances.

clue.text: Pinch Welsh leader in the wood

indicators.note: one letter goes inside the other piece

parts.note: teak is a hard tropical timber

indicators.note: the leader of the word Welsh is its first letter

explanation.surface: A Welsh chief is nabbed in the forest.
explanation.definitionFit: To tweak is to pinch and twist sharply, as one tweaks a nose.

clue.text: Check condition when put back in place

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain
a state is a condition, as in a state of repair

explanation.surface: Checking something's condition once it has been put back.
explanation.definitionFit: To reinstate is to restore someone or something to a former position.

clue.text: She merely confuses the issue

indicators.note: to confuse things is to jumble them, so the word issue is jumbled

explanation.surface: A woman who simply muddies the question.
explanation.definitionFit: Susie is a girl's given name, so a she.

clue.text: Mystery of an eastern climber lacking support

definitions.text: Mystery of an eastern climber lacking support

parts.words: Mystery of an eastern climber lacking support
parts.note: the fabled conjuring feat from the subcontinent in which a boy climbs a cord that stands upright with nothing holding it

explanation.surface: A puzzle about an Asian mountaineer with no backing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'climber' suggests a mountaineer but is a boy going up a rope held by nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary illusion has a rope rise unsupported into the air and a boy climb it.

clue.text: Wife meets bad lad — so coarse!

parts.note: in Genesis Eve was made from Adam's rib, so rib is jocular for wife

indicators.note: the letters of lad go bad, scrambled

explanation.surface: A wife encounters a naughty boy and is shocked by his vulgarity.
explanation.definitionFit: Ribald means vulgar and irreverent in a humorous way.

clue.text: One island in lovely surroundings, yet warlike

indicators.note: the outer word forms the surroundings for the inner letters

parts.note: a belle is a lovely woman
the Roman numeral for one is I
Cos (Kos) is a Greek island

explanation.surface: A single island set amid lovely scenery, yet ready for war.
explanation.definitionFit: Bellicose means aggressive and eager to fight.

clue.text: So right, entering revised dates of various kinds

indicators.note: the first pieces go into the other
something revised is reworked, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Very well, a revised list of dates turns out to be mixed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revised' gives ASTED, the shuffle of the dates; 'entering' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Assorted means mixed, made up of different sorts.

clue.text: The same bird Edward lorded it over

parts.note: do is short for ditto, meaning the same
the mina (myna) is an Asian starling
Ted is a pet form of Edward

explanation.surface: A bird called Edward bossed the others about.
explanation.definitionFit: To have dominated is to have ruled over others, to have lorded it.

clue.text: Missiles thrown on conclusion of matches

definitions.text: Missiles thrown on conclusion of matches

parts.words: Missiles thrown on conclusion of matches
parts.note: the matches are weddings, and the missiles are paper flakes thrown over the couple

explanation.surface: Objects hurled by fans at the end of football games.
explanation.walkthrough: 'matches' suggests sporting fixtures, but they are marriages.
explanation.definitionFit: Paper flakes are showered on newly-weds as they leave the ceremony.

clue.text: Final clue leads to this chemical preparation

definitions.meaning: the answer to a puzzle, which the last clue lets you reach
a liquid with a substance dissolved in it

explanation.surface: The last clue in a mystery reveals a chemical recipe.
explanation.definitionFit: It is both the answer reached by solving and a mixture of a dissolved substance in liquid.

clue.text: Victim of an asinine infatuation

parts.note: the fairy queen in A Midsummer Night's Dream, bewitched into loving Bottom, who wears a donkey's head

explanation.surface: Someone who fell foolishly in love.
explanation.walkthrough: 'asinine' seems to mean merely silly but literally means donkey-like.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakespeare's fairy queen is enchanted into doting on a weaver given a donkey's head.

clue.text: A riot, eg, being made by three of whom in Rome

definitions.text: A riot, eg, being made by three
definitions.meaning: the minimum number needed for proceedings to count; in old English law a riot needed three people
the Latin genitive plural pronoun meaning of whom

explanation.surface: A disturbance by three people, in a Latin phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: The minimum attendance for valid business comes from the Latin word meaning of whom.

clue.text: Orwell's pigs being less so?

parts.note: in Animal Farm all animals are equal but some are more equal than others; the other animals are thus less so

explanation.surface: A question about the pigs of Animal Farm.
explanation.walkthrough: The pigs are 'more equal', so everyone else is less equal than them.
explanation.definitionFit: Being less equal than the pigs makes the other beasts not the same in standing.

clue.text: Father getting nothing back for this material…

parts.note: pop is a familiar word for father

indicators.note: the word for nothing is read backwards

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A father who receives nothing in return for this cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Poplin is a plain-woven cotton fabric.

clue.text: Hence no backing for Merryman Jack, tax defaulter?

parts.note: Jack Point is the jester in Gilbert and Sullivan's The Yeomen of the Guard, who sings of 'a merryman and his maid'
someone who never files a tax form is described by the last three words

explanation.surface: A jester who would not pay his tax gets no support.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' means going back, not support. The second piece is a jokey description of a man who has filed no return.
explanation.definitionFit: The point of no return is the stage beyond which turning back is impossible.

clue.text: … dished out about a quid for this

indicators.note: the outer word wraps around the inner letter

parts.note: to have dished out money is to have paid
a quid is a pound, whose symbol is L for libra

explanation.surface: Someone paid out a pound for this.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis links to 21: 'this' is the material of the previous clue, a fabric. QUID is British slang for a pound sterling.
explanation.definitionFit: Plaid is tartan woollen cloth, so a fabric like the previous one.

clue.text: After such agreement Jack could go up the pole

definitions.text: After such agreement Jack could go up the pole

parts.words: After such agreement Jack could go up the pole
parts.note: the British flag, the Jack, was created after the joining of England, Scotland and Ireland, and is run up a flagpole

explanation.surface: Once a deal was struck, Jack was free to climb.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack' looks like a man but is the British flag, named for the joining of the kingdoms.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acts joining Britain's kingdoms were an agreement making them one.

clue.text: A cereal a pig might eat?

parts.note: corn is cereal grain

explanation.surface: A breakfast cereal fit for a pig.
explanation.definitionFit: Oak nuts are a traditional food for foraging swine.

clue.text: Army List includes unpopular name of a Jewish lawyer

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

indicators.note: the word list holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: someone in disgrace is said to have a name that is mud

explanation.surface: A military register contains a disgraced name of a Jewish lawyer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'his name is mud' means he is in disgrace.
explanation.definitionFit: A Talmudist is a scholar of the Talmud, the body of Jewish law.

clue.text: Intricate sounding act by a foreigner

indicators.note: the word means said out loud, so the answer echoes the spoken words

parts.note: an act is a deed and a foreigner an alien, with 'by a' put between

explanation.surface: Something complicated sounds like a deed done by an outsider.
explanation.walkthrough: DEED and ALIEN said together give the answer, after Daedalus, maker of the labyrinth.
explanation.definitionFit: Named after Daedalus, the builder of the labyrinth, it means ingenious and complex.

clue.text: Ruled song should be without name

indicators.note: the outer word is placed on the outside of the letter

parts.note: a lied is a German art song

explanation.surface: A ruling that a song should not name names.
explanation.definitionFit: Ruled paper is lined, marked with straight lines.
